entities.name: Kemal Türkler
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kemal Türkler was a Turkish socialist labor union leader. He was founder and first president of Confederation of Revolutionary Trade Unions of Turkey, and also one of the founders of the Workers Party of Turkey in 1963.
